thread:
maya: Quick follow-up from the postmortem  summary of owners, timelines, and recurring-patterns work for the multi-vendor outage (cloud provider auth spikes + model-registry flakiness).

maya: TL;DR: two short mitigations to ship this week, longer hardening and a drill in the next 3 sprints. I'll add items to the action tracker after we agree owners. :spiral_note_pad:

alex: I can take cloud fallback automation (cross-region routing + explicit retry windows). Prototype runbook + dry-run by EOD Friday.

jordan: I'll pick registry auth TTL rotation + improved error taxonomy (400/401/5xx) and add synthetic checks. Target PR by next Tue.

anika: I'll own alerting and runbook updates (incorporate new checks). Will add pager thresholds and a short playbook. Aim to merge alerts by Thu.

liam: We should schedule a cross-team failover drill (auth + registry + routing). Suggest Weds week-after-next. I can coordinate calendars and checklist.

maya: Proposed action items: 
- A1: cloud fallback automation (owner: alex)  dry-run Fri, merge next Tue.
- A2: registry auth TTL & error taxonomy (owner: jordan)  PR next Tue, canary rollout Thu.
- A3: alerts + runbook (owner: anika)  thresholds + runbook update by Thu.
- A4: failover drill (owner: liam)  plan doc by Mon, drill Weds week-after-next.
- A5: short-term mitigations (owner: maya)  increase auth retry backoff 500ms -> 2s for 1 minute during detected spikes (temporary).

maya: Recurring patterns observed: auth token bursts at ~20:45 UTC correlate with provider control-plane throttles; model-registry 5xxs cluster around scaler windows. Instrument these: 1) auth provider 429/5xx rate per minute, 2) registry queue length and 5xx smoothed rate, 3) fallback success-rate for cross-region reads.

alex: For A1 I'll add a shim that routes to secondary region if 3 consecutive auth calls fail within 30s, with a circuit-breaker. Question: immediate fallback or exponential backoff + retry first?

anika: Prefer retry (3x small backoff) then fallback. Track fallback metric separately and alert if fallback rate > 1% over 5m.

jordan: For registry TTL rotation, I'll add a canary that hits the registry every 15s and records 5xx/latency. Will post check config in tracker.

liam: Drill plan: simulate auth provider region outage and ensure model-serving falls back to pinned cached model and console shows degraded-but-operational. Include rollback steps.

maya: Admin: I'll create action-tracker rows A1..A5, set priorities, and assign owners. Comment on tracker if timelines change. If auth spikes >2 times in 2 weeks, escalate vendor SLA review.

deploy-bot: IncidentBot: runbook "vendor-fallbacks" updated by anika  https://redwood.internal/runbooks/vendor-fallbacks :white_check_mark:

alex: Short checklist for PR:
- enable fallback shim behind feature flag
- unit tests for retry logic
- load test 1k rps for 60s
- monitor fallback metric after deploy

jordan: I'll also add a logging field to registry responses to surface upstream provider IDs for correlation. Helps root-cause recurring patterns.

anika: One more ask  add a weekly 15m "vendor-surge" sync in incidents channel for next 6 weeks? Quick status, owners update, any new patterns.

maya: Yes, Wednesdays 09:30 PT for 6 weeks. I'll schedule and invite alex/jordan/anika/liam.

liam: Ack. Drafting drill checklist and will post in tracker by Monday.

maya: Great. I'll create tracker entries now and ping when done. :thumbsup:

anika: :eyes: thanks  I'll update alerts after PRs land.

alex: Starting prototype now, will update tracker when dry-run infra is ready.

maya: Closing loop  owners: alex(A1), jordan(A2), anika(A3), liam(A4), maya(A5). Deadlines in tracker. Swap ownership by comment if needed.

maya: End of thread  I'll post the tracker link here when created.
